newsitem.title: UK: UK to have twice yearly car plate change - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK to have twice yearly car plate change - paper.

text.p: Britain is to scrap its annual change in car number plates and will replace the system with a twice-yearly launch of new registrations, the Sunday Times newspaper said.

The paper said the change will be announced later this month by the new Labour government. It would end the traditional rush in August for new registration plates which critics claim distorts the market and increases costs.
At present British number plates begin with a letter of the alphabet which changes every August.
